description:
Rosebital is the technology team of Gulizar Zeki Obdan Anadolu Lisesi in Istanbul, Türkiye. 

Our name combines “rose” and “orbital”, inspired by the rose gardens that give our school its name. We imagine roses blooming in orbits out in space.

We are a team of high school students who love software, 3D modeling and design, and this is our first NASA Space Apps Challenge. We want to learn, build something real, and tell a story about space exploration using NASA data.
